Placemaker.Dress.NoPacks: Decorative decals need decal asset packs; none found.
Placemaker.Dress.dressAmount.Tooltip: How much wear, litter and stains dress what you build; 0 removes every decorative decal.
Placemaker.Dress.dressStyle.Tooltip: How worn the painted ground looks.
Placemaker.Dress.dressStyle.livedIn.Tool: Everyday use: worn verges and paths.
Placemaker.Dress.dressStyle.gritty.Toolt: Neglected: heavy wear and bare ground.
Placemaker.Dress.dressPaintWear.Tooltip: How much is painted into the ground texture as dressing: lawn variation, mulch under trees, worn path edges, worn patches at benches, play items and entrances, soft edges, pitch and pitch-site wear. Only where the bare ground shows (never under a surface, path or water). Permanent, like all ground paint; 0 paints nothing.
Placemaker.Dress.dressDesirePaths.Toolti: Faint trodden lines where people cut corners between paths and walk across the lawn to benches and play items (painted into the ground texture).
Placemaker.Dress.dressDesirePaths.Off: Only when Wear paint is on
Placemaker.Dress.dressLawn.Tooltip: Painted terrain: the map's own grass with lush and dry patches, mulch and wear painted in (natural, lived-in). Grass surface: one even, manicured grass texture that hides the ground (formal; also the choice on desert or rocky maps).
Placemaker.Dress.dressLawn.painted.Toolt: Bare terrain grass with painted variation and wear. Permanent paint.
Placemaker.Dress.dressLawn.surface.Toolt: A manicured grass surface over the lawn (removed with the build).
Placemaker.Dress.dressMulch.Tooltip: Dark forest-floor ground under every tree crown (soft and irregular; a neat round bed in a clean style).
Placemaker.Dress.dressLawnTint.Tooltip: Lush patches in hollows, near water and in shade, dry patches on knolls (painted lawns only).
Placemaker.Dress.dressPaintClear.Tooltip: Resets the ground texture inside the area to the plain terrain before painting — including any paint you made yourself there. Permanent.
Placemaker.Dress.dressTrees.Tooltip: Leaves and needles under trees and shrubs.
Placemaker.Dress.dressPaths.Tooltip: Leaves along path edges, worn verges, cracks and worn corners at junctions.
Placemaker.Dress.dressPaved.Tooltip: Stains, cracks and puddles on paving, with scuffs by benches and splashes round fountains.
Placemaker.Dress.dressParking.Tooltip: Oil in the bays, tyre marks at turns and entrances, repaired patches.
Placemaker.Dress.dressPlay.Tooltip: Bare ground under play items and picnic tables and in front of benches.
Placemaker.Dress.dressSports.Tooltip: Worn goalmouths and scuffs round courts and fitness stations.
Placemaker.Dress.dressGround.Tooltip: Leaves, worn patches, mud and stones on open ground.
Placemaker.Dress.dressShore.Tooltip: Wet sand, seaweed and shells along the waterline.
Placemaker.Dress.dressWorks.Tooltip: Tyre tracks along drives, mud at gates, oil under machines, dust round heaps.
Placemaker.Dress.dressRuins.Tooltip: Cracks, rubble grit, moss, glass and graffiti on old ground.
Placemaker.Dress.dressGarden.Tooltip: Mulch under shrubs and beds, leaves under hedges.
Placemaker.Dress.dressGroundDecals.Toolt: Cracks, grime, leaves, puddles and wear drawn on the ground. Off: none at all.
